independent_reimplementation.method: LC_ALL=C sort unique TSV lines of (subject_id, relation, object_id); NOVEL = comm -23 filed.tsv declared.tsv. Implemented in comm_subtract.py; does not call engine.subtract.

matching_rule.equality: exact equality of (subject_id, relation, object_id) after normalisation; no payload/prose/quote matching
matching_rule.id_normalize: strip; collapse internal whitespace to one space; preserve case
matching_rule.relation_normalize: strip; collapse whitespace; lowercase; alias {blocked_by,depends-on,dependency,dep}->depends_on, {duplicate-of,is_duplicate_of}->duplicate_of, {contradiction,contradicted_by}->contradicts, {support,supported_by}->supports, {uncovered,risk_covers,covers_artifact}->covers, {prerequisite,unknown_of,blocked_confirmation}->prerequisite_of; unknown tokens kept as lowercase
matching_rule.set_arithmetic: NOVEL = filed_normalisable MINUS declared; SUBTRACTED = intersection
